datasets.checksum_status: Official release API digest; extracted runtime files are independently pinned by freeze.

reference.status: KG-ICL adapter recipe, fitted and pinned; additional backbone
notes: Adapter fitted with the shared ULTRA/TRIX recipe (linear score-aware adapter, observed facts, bias bound 8, scale bound 2, 2i/3i source queries of FB15k237, WN18RR and CoDExMedium, source-validation checkpoint selection; training seed 2026090851) and pinned before any test run.
Backbone: DICE KG-ICL with the official KG-ICL-6L weights (nju-websoft/KG-ICL 6a3166e3), verified against the pinned code plus tests/fixtures/kgicl/upstream-fixes.patch; see docs/kgicl.md.

Prompt graphs: five examples per relation, sampled from the attached inference graph with prompt seed 0, identical for every query batch and call order; no answer-distance mask. CQD beam 64, product t-norm, paired identity control. The per-layer relation tables of every query relation are cached (projection_cache_mb 512, about 260 MiB for FB15k237); with the default 64 MiB they are recomputed on graphs with many relations, about 2.5 times slower.

reference.status: adapter training seed 1 of the KG-ICL recipe
notes: Adapter training seed 1 of the KG-ICL recipe: same prepared source queries, masks, selection queries, objective and schedule; the seed sets the initialization and the order of training batches.
Seed replicates measure adapter-training variance; no seed is selected over another.
No identity control: identity calibration takes nothing from the training seed, so the reference recipe's control serves every seed.
Backbone: DICE KG-ICL with the official KG-ICL-6L weights (nju-websoft/KG-ICL 6a3166e3), verified against the pinned code plus tests/fixtures/kgicl/upstream-fixes.patch; see docs/kgicl.md.
